messages:
maria: heads-up — rolling a config-only change now for routing + batch limits to reduce tail latency during small bursts
deploy-bot: deploy queued (cfg-id: slimdown-2026-03-21), env=prod, mode=config-only, stages=canary->gradual
deploy-bot: canary targets: 5% traffic in us-east-1 for 10m, health checks: 200 OK, p95 latency < 350ms
josh: ack. metric to watch: p95_gen_latency, kvcache_hit_ratio, and gpu_utilization per shard
lee: will watch for elevated queue depth on the inference workers — set alert thresholds to 2x baseline for 5m
maria: config diff pasted below — note lower per-tenant max_inflight and slightly tighter timeout to avoid KV pressure
```
routing:
  policy: cost-aware-fallback
  max_routes_per_request: 2
limits:
  per_tenant_max_inflight: 50  # was 100
  global_soft_limit: 12000
timeouts:
  start_to_first_token_ms: 1200  # was 2000
  idle_kv_seconds: 45  # was 60
batching:
  max_batch_size: 64  # reduced for lower tail
  preferred_latency_ms: 25
```
sam: quick Q — does this change model pinning anywhere? we should avoid accidental version switches during config-only deploys
maria: no model pins touched, only routing/limits/timeouts/batching. confirmed with the release checklist.
sre-bot: note added to incident log: slimdown-2026-03-21 config-only deploy started by maria. runbook: monitor p95 and error-rate, rollback on sustained p95 > 600ms or error-rate +0.5% for 3m
josh: schedule: canary now, ramp to 25% at +30m if healthy, full ramp at +90m. if we see kvcache hit ratio drop > 10% drop, hold and investigate
lee: I'm standing by for canary metrics. will post snapshots every 5m.
deploy-bot: canary started -> target 5% us-east-1. build: cfg slimdown-2026-03-21, id=cfg-6323
maria: if canary looks good I'll toggle the tenant-floor to give a soft breathing room for bursty tenants after full rollout
sam: adding smoke checklist: small prompt end-to-end, multi-tenant stress with 10 concurrent flows, embedding path sanity
josh: got a warning — one canary shard p95=420ms at +7m, kvcache_hit_ratio down 6% but error-rate stable
lee: digging logs: minor queue spikes on shard-3, reconnects happened briefly (60s), looks transient
maria: hold ramp for now. pausing at 5%. I don't want to push to 25% until shard-3 is stable.
deploy-bot: ramp paused per user request (maria). canary remains at 5%
lee: rolling a tiny tweak: raise idle_kv_seconds back to 55 for shard affinity while we root-cause
maria: apply that quick tweak and re-run canary health checks. notify here when patch is applied.
deploy-bot: config update applied (cfg-id: slimdown-2026-03-21-v2), idle_kv_seconds=55. canary health probes restarting
josh: new probe at +14m shows p95=310ms and kvcache_hit_ratio back to within 1% of baseline — looking stable
lee: shard-3 queue depth back to normal, no reconnects in last 6m\maria: ok proceed with scheduled ramp: 25% in 5m, full in 90m if no regressions. keep alerts loud. :loud_sound:
sam: will run the smoke flows at +5m and post results
sre-bot: reminder: rollback command = /deploy rollback cfg-6323 -> previous config (auto snapshot created)
lee: FYI I'm leaving watch for the full ramp window. handoff to oncall at +100m if still green
josh: thanks team. post-mortem if anything odd, otherwise I'll add release note: "slimdown config: routing and batching limits adjusted to lower tail latency; minor kv idle tweak"
maria: closing thread once full ramp completes. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
